title: gf2-core competitive performance
description:
Milestone tracking the project's vision goal: gf2-core competitive with Magma/Sage on the kernels they ship, and pushing beyond on extension-field tower arithmetic. Currently scoped to one epic; future performance epics (e.g. gf2-coding LDPC throughput, GPU offload research) will hang under this milestone too.

## Currently scoped

- **Epic `babcf05e`** — gf2-core PPC-spiral performance sweep. Comprehensive sweep through every scalar gap with proof-of-gain at every spiral step (≥1.5× geomean over pinned baseline; no merge below the bar).

## Long-term success criteria

- [hard] Every Tier A–D kernel from epic `babcf05e` ships its proof-of-gain artefact (criterion delta + asm + perf-stat).
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-simd` / `gf2-kernels-hip` (apex constraint preserved).
- [hard] MSRV drift only happens with explicit user approval per `escalation-policy.md`.
- [aspirational] On a representative workload (LDPC-coded simulation, tower-field GEMM), gf2-core matches or beats Magma 2.28 on a single core.
- [aspirational] Open future room for gf2-coding throughput epics, GPU offload epics, and verification-coverage epics under this milestone without restructure.
